description: Shared Renovate preset for the WeTrade cluster ecosystem. Consumed by all workload repos via `extends: ["github>wondering-developer/cluster-baseline//renovate-config/default"]`. Handles three digest-pinning schemas across Helm charts + raw k8s manifests.

customManagers.description: Schema A: `image: <name>` + `imageDigest: <sha256>` across helm values.yaml. Annotation `# renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name> [currentValue=<tag>] [versioning=<v>]` on the line directly above imageDigest. currentValue is optional — defaults to 'latest' for pure-digest tracking; set it explicitly to pin a major/minor (e.g. mariadb 10.6) so Renovate only bumps digests of that tag stream.
Schema C fallback: inline `image: <name>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>` in contexts the built-in kubernetes-manager does not scan (e.g. `values/*.yaml` outside helm/).

packageRules.description: Own-built images (sebastart/*) are pinned via CI per deploy — never Renovate's job.
Major bumps of upstream images need manual approval (not auto-PR). See dependency dashboard.
Group upstream digest-only updates per image — avoids PR storms when a tag gets a silent rebuild.
Helm chart upgrades (Chart.yaml / chart-versions.yaml) — one PR per chart, weekly.
Security updates bypass the weekly schedule.
GitHub Actions: pin by SHA, weekly bumps.
